title: erysimum capitatum var. amoenum
intro: Erysimum capitatum var. amoenum, commonly known as Western wallflower, is a plant species native to the western United States. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects. The therapeutic actions of Erysimum capitatum var. amoenum include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isothiocyanates, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
